data.exact_reserve_text: A surplus/(deficit) run-off deviation of (GBP 3.0) million was experienced in 2015 (2014: GBP 1.3 million surplus). This was made up of a surplus on the prior year claims provisions of GBP 4.7 million on direct business (2014: GBP 2.0 million surplus) and a GBP 7.7 million deficit on reinsurance accepted business (2014: GBP 0.7 million deficit).
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 were GBP 100.728m. During 2015 there was a net adverse prior year development of GBP 3.0m (approx. 2.98% of opening gross reserves), driven by a GBP 7.7m deficit on reinsurance accepted business partially offset by a GBP 4.7m surplus on direct business. Overall the movement represents a small strengthening of reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: A surplus/(deficit) run-off deviation of (GBP 3.0) million was experienced in 2015 (2014: GBP 1.3 million surplus).

This was made up of a surplus on the prior year claims provisions of GBP 4.7 million on direct business (2014: GBP 2.0 million surplus) and a GBP 7.7 million deficit on reinsurance accepted business (2014: GBP 0.7 million deficit).
The result has also been impacted by large loss activity, particularly in the Contingency sector.
These include a loss of plant and equipment in a mining landslide, a contractor's liability claim and a number of power claims.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding and movement figures are taken from the 'Claims outstanding' note and the accompanying run-off deviation narrative on page 36. Opening and premium figures are presented in the accounts in GBP 000; values here converted to millions. Prior year development (gross) was derived from the run-off decomposition: +GBP 7.7m deficit on reinsurance accepted business offset by GBP 4.7m surplus on direct business yielding a net gross strengthening of GBP 3.0m. No explicit gross PY movement table labelled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' with separate 'Insurance liabilities' column was found; the run-off paragraph was used as the authoritative gross breakdown. No specific named catastrophe events were quantified in the reserves note.
